mods.name: Snorlax (Boomer)
mods.description:
Play the PokéFlute they said, it'll be fine they said...

What's large, round, hungry, and about to cover you with its extremely acidic digestive juices? Why, it's a Snorlax, the Sleeping Pokémon! Its thick fat helps it withstand heat, cold and poisoning. Well, it's a good thing bullets aren't elemental!
Comes with a Boomette replacement. Now I know what you're thinking, male and female Snorlaxes look the same. Well, don't worry, that's been taken care of!
Expect it to be a bit bigger than your average Boomer. Snorlaxes are large creatures after all.

Features:
Boomette
Exploded Model
UI Icons
Viewmodel Arms

If you're wondering why it's using the Super Smash Bros. for Wii U model instead of a proper Pokémon one, well, personal preferences, really. I didn't want to make it look cartoony because it'd stand out too much.

Great big thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198046141851/] Szalitar PL[/url] for having this idea in the first place.

Snorlax model ripped by "ThatTrueStruggle" on The Models Resource
Bow model ripped by "Hallow" on The Models Resource
I know it's a bow tie, alright?

mods.name: [VSCRIPT] Ragdoll Magnitude & Drive Tweaks
mods.description:
This is a mod that makes the ragdolls similar to their L4D1 counterparts; very launchable. L4D2 made them to be rather static, so this mod fixes that. It also changes the "drive" which (could very well be placebo) launches the ragdoll in the direction they were attacked from.

This applies to all client sided ragdolls in the game, should work with all campaigns and mutations. Should also be compatible with custom .phy ragdolls. You will need a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1932686022]survivor ragdoll mod[/url] if you want to see survivor ragdolls.

[b]This mod is server-sided. It will only work locally or on dedicated servers, but only the host/server needs it[/b]

[b]Update: Now configurable![/b]

mods.name: Lux's Survivor Legs script
mods.description:
[b]NOTICE: This addon uses scripts. This will not work in Dedicated servers. Use local/listen servers, or singleplayer instead.[/b]
An upside to this is that if you can see this addon's effects, [i]everyone else can.[/i]

This is a port-to-VScript of [b][u]Lux's Survivor Legs plugin[/u][/b]. [url=https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=299560]link here[b][/b][/url] [i](ah yes, reports galore)[/i]
Yes, it works with custom models. But it's not flawless, and you may face clipping or duplicate arm issues with them.

For the most part, it works like the plugin. Most of the internal workings are kept the same, albeit translated over to VScript.

It comes with displaying your pistols, throwable and health items on your legs. However, this can be buggy on multiplayer with people that have custom models.

[h1]Technical Stuff[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2865107042/3391798007030752899/]Click here to know about other features of this mod like changeable settings.[/url]

[u]Bugs:[/u]
[strike][i]- The USE button will occasionally be blocked due to the legs. Try looking more up or down.[/i][/strike] [i](Fix applied)[/i]
[strike][i]- The legs will take a few seconds to properly load when you spawn into the map, are respawned from a closet or revived by a defibrillator.[/i][/strike] [i](Fix applied)[/i]

[h1]Before you ask 'Does this work on Official Dedicated?'[/h1]
The only way for legs to work on Official Dedicated is to modify the viewmodels, just like the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2490500647]old and buggy viewmodel legs.[/url]
There's no way around it. Official Dedicated servers do not accept any script files.

mods.name: 22 Tic Tac Pills (RNG)
mods.description:
[h1]Update 2020[/h1]
[code]I added 6 new flavors (incl. Tic-Tac Gum), SYS (Select Your Skins) support, and changed the RNG.[/code]

[h1]Update 2016[/h1]
[code]I added 3 new flavors since you guys did like that mod a lot :D  - Banana, Piña Colada and Mint Rush. I also fixed some minor light bugs and a bug on the back etiquette[/code]

This mod is the ultimate remaster of something I did more than 2 years ago : Tic Tac Pills. Tic Tac is a brand of small and hard mints that are produced by the Ferrero (ITA), they are usually avaliable in all parts of the globe and you certainly already tasted some.
Today, these delicious mints come to L4D2 in [b]16 different flavors[/b]. The textures are genuine and brand new and HD. This addon doesn't includes custom sound because the original sounds fits the thing perfectly, so no conflict with your hypothetical sound mods.
Moreover, this mod is the first one that is not a remaster and that natively includes the "[b]Pure RNG[/b]" System : there are multiple different boxes of Tic-Tac per map and [u]you end up with the last one you picked or tried to pick[/u] :D. So much more variety =).
I did the textures myself because I couldn't find ultra HD ones, so all Tic-Tac boxes have native Full-HD graphics.
Everything being said, hit subscribe and just make sure that Louis doesn't eat them all'

Enjoy :)

mods.name: Ellie for Rochelle | TLOU2
mods.description:
[h1] Seattle Day 2 Ellie for Rochelle | The Last of Us Part 2

[b]Check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2885191484]Ellie for Zoey[/url]![/b]
[b]Ellie for all [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1I2Mm__gm6zfdC6Wqwk32XYFXL7AT3VhX/view?usp=sharing]L4D1[/url]and [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Q2_oCnUbk5oEHFBwIDr_wRTTC6VqNL4s/view?usp=sharing]L4D2 survivors[/url][/b][/h1]

This mod was commissioned by [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198305251271/]ScratchNSniff[/url]. Thank you for ordering from me!

And here I offer you Ellie Williams from TLOU2! She always needed a proper port of this skin to the game. The mod was originally made in July, but I've had a lot of commissions (that I most likely won't post) and life stuff going on, I just didn't have energy to post this, but here we are! 

I also want to thank the commissioner for making the order because it's what finally made me watch TLOU2's playthrough. And it was wonderful.

[h1] Features [/h1]
● First person arms
● Facial expressions (some were exported from TLOU2!!!)
● VGUI pictures
● Jigglebones for hair, backpack, its zips, and bottom of the shirt like in TLOU2
● Gun attachments like in TLOU2 (main and melee on backpack's sides, pistol tucked into the jeans)
● Zoey's animations

[h1] Bugs [/h1]
Not that I know of. Tell me if you find any!
